threads.body: `GenAIInvocation` is re-exported as a public type, so making this new keyword-only argument required breaks existing callers that instantiate it or subclass it and forward the previously supported constructor arguments; they now fail with `TypeError` before an invocation can be created. The PR is marked non-breaking, so preserve the old call shape (for example, make this optional and normalize `None` to an empty mapping) or deprecate the public constructor before requiring the argument.

threads.body: Could we keep `_start_attributes` private instead of exposing it publicly? Unlike `invocation.attributes` (which callers mutate before finishing), modifying `start_attributes` after `__init__` won't update the span. Keeping it internal avoids expanding the public API surface.
